Final review complete. The only change is in src/dotenv/main.py, `set_key`'s quoted branch (lines 184-187):

```python
if quote:
    value_out = "'{}'".format(
        value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")
    )
else:
    value_out = value_to_set
```

Backslashes are escaped before apostrophes, so each literal `\` becomes `\\` and each `'` becomes `\'` — both valid single-quote escapes. `dotenv_values(interpolate=False)` now reproduces the exact value, including consecutive backslashes and backslash-before-quote cases. The `quote_mode` validation, `always`/`auto`/`never` selection, and `export` handling are untouched. Host acceptance and selected upstream regression tests passed.

Remaining limitations: none within scope. `quote_mode='never'` still writes raw values (unchanged, by design), and no tests or docs were modified per instructions.
